title: Example — REPAIR stage (de-CH): only the flagged spans are rewritten, everything else stays untouched

segments.source_text: Vraag een vrijblijvende offerte aan bij onze <a1>servicedienst</a1>.
segments.current_text: Fordern Sie ein unverbindliches Angebot bei unserem <a1>Kundendienst</a1> an.

findings.explanation: In Swiss B2B German a quotation is an "Offerte"; "Angebot" reads as German usage. [EVIDENCE: DECH-LEX-OFFERTE]
findings.suggested_fix: Use "Offerte" and adjust article and adjective endings (ein Angebot → eine Offerte).

thinking: Only span s1 is flagged. Offerte is feminine, so the article and adjective change too: ein unverbindliches Angebot → eine unverbindliche Offerte. The span contains no tags; nothing else may change.

repairs.reason: [EVIDENCE: DECH-LEX-OFFERTE] Offerte is the Swiss term; article and adjective re-inflected for the feminine noun.
